'''Manderic''' is one of the [[Mera'din]] with the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc|Manderic}}}}

==Activities==
Led by [[Efalin]], Manderic and others with [[Sevanna]]'s Shaido capture [[Faile]] and some of her entourage. Manderic takes [[Chiad]] as his ''[[gai'shain]]''{{ref/book|8|30}}.

Manderic leads Chiad back to the Shaido camp. He carries her after she develops frostbite{{ref/book|9|3}}. 

[[Therava]] and [[Someryn]] dismiss Manderic and the others when they come to inspect the new ''gai'shain''{{ref/book|9|4}}.

[[Bain]] tells Faile to inform [[Gaul]] that Chiad has been captured by "a man with strong hands, a man whose heart is fire"{{ref/book|11|28}}. He also drinks a lot.

In the battle at [[Malden]]{{ref/book|11|29}}{{ref/book|11|30}}, Gaul kills Manderic thus taking Chiad as ''gai'shain''. Some time after the battle Faile and the others captured along her carefully burn some mementos to honour the memory of the Aiel that helped them{{ref/book|12|21}}.
